task_metadata.research_topic: training objectives for flow matching and mean-velocity generative image models
task_metadata.research_question: Can we improve upon MeanFlow's training objective to achieve better FID on CIFAR-10 with a small DiT and a 10-step Euler sampler?
notes: Baseline-to-paper mappings were verified against edits/meanflow.edit.py, edits/alphaflow.edit.py, and edits/pureflow.edit.py.
All BibTeX entries were obtained via the paper_cite MCP tool; none were handwritten.

tests.label: train_small
tests.notes: Small-budget CIFAR-10 training/evaluation on a DiT-style backbone using FID.

tests.label: train_medium
tests.notes: Medium-budget CIFAR-10 training/evaluation on a DiT-style backbone using FID.

tests.label: train_large
tests.notes: Largest-budget CIFAR-10 training/evaluation on a DiT-style backbone using FID.

baselines.name: meanflow
baselines.notes: Matches the MeanFlow objective described in the edit stub: average-velocity training with JVP-based targets.

baselines.name: alphaflow
baselines.notes: Matches the AlphaFlow edit stub: annealing from discrete trajectory training toward MeanFlow.

baselines.name: pureflow
baselines.notes: The baseline is plain flow matching with instantaneous velocity targets; the nearest canonical paper is Flow Matching for Generative Modeling.

papers.title: Mean Flows for One-step Generative Modeling
papers.relevance: Introduces the MeanFlow objective that the task asks the agent to improve upon.

papers.title: AlphaFlow: Understanding and Improving MeanFlow Models
papers.relevance: Directly matches the AlphaFlow baseline that anneals from trajectory flow matching toward MeanFlow.

papers.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
papers.relevance: Canonical flow-matching paper for the pure instantaneous-velocity baseline used as the task's simplest comparator.

papers.title: Improving and generalizing flow-based generative models with minibatch optimal transport
papers.relevance: Extends flow matching into generalized and optimal-transport variants, directly relevant to alternative training objectives for this task.

papers.title: Flow Straight and Fast: Learning to Generate and Transfer Data with Rectified Flow
papers.relevance: A major antecedent for few-step flow-based generation, useful context for improving low-NFE generation quality.

papers.title: Stochastic Interpolants: A Unifying Framework for Flows and Diffusions
papers.relevance: Provides theoretical context for objective design across continuous-time transport, diffusion, and flow formulations.

papers.title: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers
papers.bibtex: @inproceedings{Peebles_2023, title={Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers}, url={http://dx.doi.org/10.1109/iccv51070.2023.00387}, DOI={10.1109/iccv51070.2023.00387}, booktitle={2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)}, publisher={IEEE}, author={Peebles, William and Xie, Saining}, year={2023}, month=oct, pages={4172-4182} }
papers.relevance: The task description specifies a small DiT backbone; this is the defining DiT architecture paper.

papers.title: SiT: Exploring Flow and Diffusion-based Generative Models with Scalable Interpolant Transformers
papers.relevance: Extends DiT-style backbones to interpolant and flow objectives, making it directly relevant to objective changes on transformer generators.

papers.title: GANs Trained by a Two Time-Scale Update Rule Converge to a Local Nash Equilibrium
papers.relevance: Introduces the Fréchet Inception Distance used as the task's optimization target and evaluation metric.

papers.title: Learning Multiple Layers of Features from Tiny Images
papers.venue: TIB record for the CIFAR technical report
papers.relevance: This record covers the original CIFAR technical report that defines the CIFAR-10 dataset used by the task.
